name: Depth of Field for Bitrate Control
aliases: Varying depth of field for graceful degradation
definition: A technique to control video bitrate in cloud rendering by varying the camera's depth of field (aperture). Narrow depth of field blurs the background, reducing image detail and thus lowering the video bit rate/file size.
summary: Depth of Field for Bitrate Control uses aperture adjustments to blur backgrounds, reducing video bitrate by lowering image entropy rather than serving as an artistic optical effect.
